question: In MS-Excel 365, the _______ between two columns is an indicator that we have hidden a column.
solution:
The correct answer is __**double line**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **double line** between two columns is an indicator that a column has been hidden in MS-Excel 365.
 
• When a column is hidden, the border between the adjacent columns appears as a double line, which helps users identify hidden columns quickly.
 
• This feature is useful for managing large datasets and maintaining a clean, organized view of the works
